truthful_boundaries: This is the readable receipt storage G3 needs, not the gate itself: nothing in the publication path yet requires a catalog entry to exist.

Register accepts entries whose canonical_id was computed by openviking/wiki/identity.py resolve_candidate_identity, but does not recompute or verify the derivation — identity compiler output remains trusted-at-boundary input.
Alias ownership is enforced at write time only; pre-existing legacy rows are impossible (fresh tables), so no backfill/migration surface exists by design.
G2 (derived_access dependency keys on wiki contribution sources) and G3 (check_build_profile consuming real receipts) remain open before strict_diagnostic can flip diagnostic_publishable.
